youtube.title: Night Prayer Today | Psalm 127:2 KJV
youtube.text:
Worked all day? This one's for you.

"It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep." Psalm 127:2 (KJV)

Fall asleep to the Word: Psalms 125–150, KJV, read slowly: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2V6mjKBs0yo

Type amen, and send this to someone who can't sleep.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#NightPrayer #BibleVersesForSleep #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
